issue.title: [monit] Report status error for bgpcfgd bgpmon and lldpmgrd

failure.body:
**Description**

* `bgpcfgd`, `bgpmon` and `lldpmgrd` are reported not running by `monit` due to the transition to `Python3` in recent changes.
```
Nov  9 <IPV6>.522018 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR monit[519]: 'lldp|lldpmgrd' status failed (1) -- 'python /usr/bin/lldpmgrd' is not running.
Nov  9 <IPV6>.657516 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR monit[519]: 'bgp|bgpcfgd' status failed (1) -- '/usr/bin/python /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd' is not running.
Nov  9 <IPV6>.700837 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR monit[519]: 'bgp|bgpmon' status failed (1) -- '/usr/bin/python /usr/local/bin/bgpmon' is not running.
```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.

**Describe the results you received:**

```
root      1182  0.5  0.4  27512 16844 ?        Ss   Nov08   3:03 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/procdockerstatsd
root      2192  5.9  0.8 121280 35508 pts/0    Sl   03:41   6:06 python3 -m sonic_ax_impl
admin    21134  0.0  0.0   6824   892 pts/0    S+   05:25   0:00 grep python3
root     29809  0.0  0.6 258356 25504 ?        Ssl  03:40   0:01 python3 /usr/bin/core_uploader.py
root     31445  0.0  0.6 256580 27808 ?        Sl   03:41   0:00 python3 /usr/bin/docker-wait-any -s swss -d syncd teamd
root     32074  0.0  0.5  39704 23836 pts/0    S    03:41   0:01 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd
root     32092  0.0  0.3  21980 15180 pts/0    S    03:41   0:00 /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/bgpmon
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
No error message in syslog reporting this.

resolution.title: [monit] Fix status error due to shebang change
resolution.description:
lldpmgrd, bgpcfgd, and bgpmon are reported error status not running due
to recent change of shebang to use `Python3`. Modifying the argument of
`process_checker` to follow this change.

fixes #5864

Signed-off-by: Longxiang Lyu <<EMAIL>>

**- Why I did it**
```

Nov  9 <IPV6>.916896 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR monit[519]: 'bgp|bgpcfgd' status failed (1) -- '/usr/bin/python /usr/local/bin/bgpcfgd' is not running.
Nov  9 <IPV6>.941334 str-dx010-acs-4 ERR monit[519]: 'bgp|bgpmon' status failed (1) -- '/usr/bin/python /usr/local/bin/bgpmon' is not running.
```
